title.narrative: Promotion of Irish potato production through the improvement of farmers' access to quality Irish potato seeds in Rulindo district

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to To promote food and nutrition security as well as food systems resilience in Rwanda. This will be achieved through two outcomes;

Outcome 1: Increased sustainable food production of Irish potato producers in the Rulindo District.

Outcome 2: Improved incomes and access to the market for Irish potato producers.

The following outputs will contribute to the achievement of the above outcome and objective;

·     Output 1: Increased sustainable supply of safe and quality of Irish potato seeds to smallholder farmers and farmer cooperatives/groups,

·      Output 2: Sustainable agricultural practices are promoted,

·      Output 3: The Irish potato value chain and market linkages are enhanced.
